name: Joint Ops: Terror on Devlan Mission Pack
description: Non-player operatives from Kill Team: Terror on Devlan (Red Terror, Termagants, Ripper Swarms). Sourced from the Terror on Devlan dossier, Warhammer Community articles, and tabletop reviews until KTDash publishes this pack.

operatives.name: Red Terror (Hunt)
operatives.abilities:
Behaviour: When activated, if this NPO can perform either of its first two actions during that activation, give it an Engage order. If it cannot, give it a Conceal order.

1. Fight.
2. Charge the closest player operative via the shortest possible route.
3. Shoot the closest player operative.
4. Reposition towards the closest player operative (a subsequent Dash action can fulfil this, if able).
5. Dash towards the closest player operative.

Swallow Whole: After each critical success when fighting, roll one D6: if the result is higher than the target's remaining wounds, that operative is incapacitated and this operative regains wounds equal to the roll.

Never Incapacitated: Whenever this operative would be incapacitated while using this datacard, it is not. Instead it switches to the Red Terror (Lurk) datacard, regains all wounds, and is removed from the killzone until it can set up again as described in the mission pack.

Rampage: This operative can move through terrain parts less than 2" tall and through other operatives (excluding NEMESIS operatives). Whenever it performs the Fight action, measure control range 1" horizontally and 4" vertically.

operatives.name: Red Terror (Lurk)
operatives.abilities:
Behaviour: When activated, give it a Conceal order. It cannot perform the Shoot or Fight actions while on this datacard.

1. Reposition more than 5" from all player operatives, or into its drop zone if possible.
2. Dash more than 5" from all player operatives, or into its drop zone if possible.

Regenerate: While on this datacard, at the start of each Strategy phase after it switched, it regains D3+3 lost wounds (or all wounds, as specified by the mission).

Return to Hunt: When it next activates after regenerating, replace this datacard with Red Terror (Hunt) and set it up as described in the mission pack.

Never Incapacitated: Whenever this operative would be incapacitated while using this datacard, it is not. It may gain a Regeneration token or reduce its permanent wounds maximum instead, as described in the mission pack.

operatives.name: Termagant
operatives.abilities:
Behaviour: When activated, if this NPO can perform the Shoot action during that activation, give it an Engage order. If it cannot, give it a Conceal order.

1. Fall Back. If possible, to a location where there is a valid target.
2. Reposition towards the closest player operative, to cover if possible. Additionally, to a location where there is a valid target if possible.
3. Shoot.
4. Dash towards the closest player operative, to cover if possible.
5. Fight.
operatives.notes: Same profile as other Tyranid Joint Ops Termagants (e.g. Typhon / Titus packs).

1. Fight.
2. Charge the closest player operative via the shortest possible route.
3. Reposition towards the closest player operative (a subsequent Dash action can fulfil this, if able).
4. Dash towards the closest player operative.
operatives.notes: Supporting brood NPO for Terror on Devlan.
